rules: Each JSON file is validated against its JSON Schema (2020-12) in /data/schemas/kolaboro-data.schema.json. The contracts were written from the files as published on 5 Nov 2026: every top-level key is required with its type, items of top-level lists and maps must keep the keys every item had, numbers are "number", deeper optional values may be null. Parquet files are checked against the columns and row count in kolaboro.parquet.json, tiles and screenshots against their binary headers. API answers are validated against the response schemas in /docs/api/openapi.json, which were inferred from live responses.
